proof_requests: Back label/model sticker photo (brand + exact model number).
Power-on video showing the home/menu screen (confirm it turns on and displays properly).
Screen test clip/photos: solid colors + grid to check lines/dead pixels.
Photos of included items: remote, stand/base, power cable, and any accessories.
